title: Paulie Christian and a Dallas band
summary: Interviewer asks about Frenchie Christian; Albert's answer is garbled by ASR.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: You know that man, Paulie Christian, Frenchie or whatever you want to call him?

There was a little band in Dallas where Blaine Johnson was here. That's the one that Richard McCawfield and myself and Richard Johnson came. He was a very, very, very person that got sick and he would stop playing.
Oh, but did he play with you ever?
No. Yes, he actually got well. He played to Gates, but not too much.
He wasn't playing? He wasn't playing at home?
